Name: Rabbitcake's talkohlooeys-style Beatrice Portraits
Author: rabbitcakes
Description:
The idea was just to make Beatrice fit better into my Talkohlooeys style Pelican Town.I have tweaked and changed the details of Beatrice's portrait to my liking, and I hope this has not changed the impression she makes on your mind.

      Please do message me if you're offended!

      I'm a native Chinese speaker, so I apologise for the poor English. ^v^  Just have fun


[size=4][size=3]Required mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url][/size]
[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7042]Beatrice NPC[/url]

[/size]Install instructions:
1. Install the required mods listed
2. Extract the folder and move all the PNGs and their .pytk files into the directory "[CP] Delores/assets/Portraits", then replace the files when prompted.
3. Run the game using SMAPI
